verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a scheduling product, since self-hostable scheduling tools exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Calendly offering a self-hosted or on-premises deployment. Every item describes Calendly's hosted cloud service and its APIs, embeds, webhooks and MCP server, which are integration surfaces rather than self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
